SUBJECT:

NOC TO SUB-DIVISION OF PLOT NO. 196, BLOCK “B”, manzoor colony,
jamshed TOWN, KARACHI.

On acceptance of Sub-Division fee & other Charges as admissible under Section 26, Sub-Section (4) of SKAA (Regulation, Improvement & Development) Regulation 1993. Plot No.  , measuring   Sq. Yards is Sub-Divided into Two portion, now said plot New No.  , Measuring   Sq. Yards & Plot No.  , Measuring   Sq. Yards with Residential status making on the following terms & conditions.

1. There shall be no claim on the part of owners of plots No. 196 & 196/I in case any claim is arisen the said Sub-Division shall be liable to be withdrawn and set aside.

2. That no Building structure shall be raised without approval of Building Plan by S.B.C.A & prior NOC from this department.

3. No, easement rights of Sub-Divided plot holders shall disturbed.

4. Road / Street / Lane shall keep intact according to approved layout Plan.
